scenes.text: How to tell *good tacos* before you order

scenes.sub: Fresh corn tortillas off the griddle are the biggest difference. A cold packet tortilla can't be saved.
Three or four house salsas at different heats. One bottle of hot sauce means they don't care.
The best taquerias sell five or six fillings, not forty items and a burger.
That's the traditional topping. The meat is supposed to carry it.

scenes.text: New place? If you see a spit of pork with pineapple, *order al pastor.*
